name: Insperity People Parser
description: This extension parses any relevant contact information on the current page into your Insperity Account

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://*.fontawesome.com; font-src 'self' data: https://*.fontawesome.com; connect-src 'self' http://*.linkedin.com https://*.linkedin.com https://insperity.brightmove.com/ATS/;
